answer: One defence is proof of unique fishing vessel registration with maritime authority attestation: a registration the maritime authority keeps on its vessel roll, and the bridge of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The wharf grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big. The walnut is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
